title: Loyalty wallet
summary: Wallet spend at checkout and earn on paid orders. Permission loyalty. Dashboard card on slot.admin.dashboard.

rows: 30. extraLines loyalty-credit and plugins[tuucho-commerce-loyalty] { credit, earn, earnStatus }

blocks.title: Call the service
blocks.text: peekPluginService('tuucho-commerce-loyalty'). Do not import this plugin's http/ or infrastructure/. Checkout is server-authoritative; the client preview is not trusted.

items.description: loyalty on the manifest. Nav Admin → Loyalty.
front/AdminDashboardCard.tsx uses ui.AdminStatCard on slot.admin.dashboard. The kernel stats grid owns width.
CRUD is the Loyalty admin page, not /admin/plugins/:id.

blocks.text: Bundled path: tuucho-config/plugins/tuucho-commerce-loyalty/ (public config.json, gitignored config.private.json, committed config.private.example.json). Merge matches kernel JSON (common then env, private or example). Boot does not overwrite Admin values. First launch loads files once when settings are still empty. Edit in Admin → Plugins → Configure, or Update from files / Import / Export there. Admin → Plugins Update all / Import all / Export all uses the same files (schema plugins only; no extra register).

items.description: number — public. Loyalty points granted per 100 € spent. Change only when you rewrite the program.
number — public. Months a points lot stays usable before it burns.
number — public. How many weeks before burn the customer gets a notice.
number — public. Days between burn-reminder mails while a lot is in the notice window.
string — public. JSONL path for the loyalty cron. Change only if you relocated kernel logs.
